title: A smooth talker can sell rotten shrimp
odia:
କହି ପୋଛି ପାରେ ଯେ
ପଚା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡି ବିକେ ସେ।
literal_meaning: Whoever can talk persuasively can sell rotten shrimp.
meaning_odia: ଚତୁର ଭାବରେ କଥା କହି ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ମନାଇ ପାରୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ଖରାପ ଜିନିଷକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ବିକି ପାରେ। ପଚା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡିର ଚିତ୍ରରେ କଥାର ଚମକ ଓ ଜିନିଷର ଅସଲ ମାନ ମଧ୍ୟର ଫରକ ଧରାପଡ଼େ।
explanation: Persuasive speech can make even an undesirable thing seem worth buying. The rotten shrimp give the saying its sharp edge: selling skill and the quality of what is sold are two different things. The inspected article uses a close variant to illustrate the power of salesmanship.
usage_example: An enthusiastic sales pitch makes a badly worn item sound like an exceptional bargain. A listener recalls the saying while looking past the pitch to inspect the item. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The image places polished speech beside spoiled goods. That contrast allows the line to acknowledge verbal skill while making the listener aware of what the words may conceal.

witnesses.locator: Opening discussion of online sales; paragraph beginning ବିକ୍ରୀ କରି ଜାଣିଲେ, indexed excerpt inspected17November2026.
witnesses.note: Variant କହି-ବୋଲି ପାରିଲା ଯିଏ, ପଚା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ବିକି ପାରିଲା ସିଏ. Confirms rotten-shrimp sales image and persuasive-talk reading, not exact uploaded ପୋଛି wording. Direct page open failed; indexed article excerpt includes byline/date and this context. Public ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି differs orthographically from uploaded display ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡି, which is retained.

odia_summary: ଚତୁର କଥାରେ ଖରାପ ଜିନିଷ ବି ବିକିହୁଏ।
english_summary: A convincing pitch can hide the poor quality of what is offered.
